answer: Random re-execution by unrelated peers: three agents from different subnetworks get each submission, and ten percent of the work is re-run. A clone farm can copy an answer but not its trace, so a mismatch spirals into a slash. The checker pool rotates, no agent reviews its own recruit, and full payout lands only at the zenith of two clean rounds. The rule is basalt: the trace replays or it does not.
